trans-unit.target: Glory be to the Father, and the Son, and the Holy Spirit.

trans-unit.source:
As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end.
Amen.
trans-unit.target:

Amen.

trans-unit.source: Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee; blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.
trans-unit.target: Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee; blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.

trans-unit.source:
Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now, and at the hour of our death.
Amen.
trans-unit.target:
Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now, and at the hour of our death.
Amen.

trans-unit.source:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.
Amen.
trans-unit.target:
In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.
Amen.

trans-unit.source: Pray for us, O holy Mother of God.
trans-unit.target: Pray for us, O holy Mother of God.

trans-unit.source: That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.
trans-unit.target: That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

trans-unit.source:
O God, whose only begotten Son, by His life, death and resurrection, has purchased for us the rewards of eternal life, grant, we beseech Thee, that meditating on these mysteries of the Most Holy Rosary of the Blessed Virgin Mary, we may imitate what they contain, and obtain what they promise, through the same Christ, our Lord.
Amen.
trans-unit.target:
O God, whose only begotten Son, by His life, death and resurrection, has purchased for us the rewards of eternal life, grant, we beseech Thee, that meditating on these mysteries of the Most Holy Rosary of the Blessed Virgin Mary, we may imitate what they contain, and obtain what they promise, through the same Christ, our Lord.
Amen.

trans-unit.source:
Oh my Jesus, forgive us our sins, save us from the fires of hell; lead all souls to heaven, especially those in most need of your mercy!
Amen.
trans-unit.target:
Oh my Jesus, forgive us our sins, save us from the fires of hell; lead all souls to heaven, especially those in most need of your mercy!
Amen.

trans-unit.source:
Hail, Holy Queen, Mother of Mercy, our life, our sweetness, and our hope. To thee do we cry, poor banished children of Eve. To thee do we send up our sighs, mourning and weeping in this vale of tears. Turn then, most gracious advocate, thine eyes of mercy towards us, and after this our exile show unto us the blessed fruit of thy womb, Jesus. O clement, O loving, O sweet Virgin Mary.
Amen
trans-unit.target:
